digest.component_or_area: close disposition and precheck command module
propositions: Three near-identical replacement-link walkers exist across close_disposition.py, close_precheck.py, and gates.py that differ only in liveness check and return type, creating maintenance burden and inconsistency risk exemplified by bug frolicky-dependable-peccary

The duplicates/supersedes walk logic must be consolidated into a single function while preserving class-guard differences (find_replacement guards on DISPOSITION_CLASSES only; _has_live_replacement_link additionally narrows non-bugs to ADMINISTRATIVE_CLASSES; _recorded_replacement_target has no guard)

The reduce-failure behavior must diverge: live-mode callers stop early on subject reduce failure, while _recorded_replacement_target continues to inbound scan, requiring the core function to accept an on_subject_unreadable parameter
Monkeypatch seams _has_live_replacement_link, _recorded_replacement_target, and find_replacement must retain exact names and signatures to prevent silent test failures when patched with raising=False
_NON_COMPLETION_BUG_CLASSES in close_precheck.py must become an alias to close_disposition.DISPOSITION_CLASSES to prevent the two sets from drifting apart

A construct-uniqueness guard must enforce that the duplicates/supersedes walk conjunction appears only in close_disposition.py (except owner module and marked escapes) to prevent re-introduction of the consolidated logic
